summary: There's a part of you that knows a need to be seen and to matter and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something flow together so easily you can take it for granted. It comes naturally - you shine and lead without trying and you reach, grow, and lift the room - which is exactly why it's easy to coast on.
body: There's a part of you that knows a need to be seen and to matter and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something flow together so easily you can take it for granted. gift: At your best: you shine and lead without trying, and you reach, grow, and lift the room.
shadow: The trap: you make it all about you, or you shrink when no one's looking - or you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver.
integration: Let identity and growth and belief cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Confidence and opportunity, with overextension as the standing risk.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you shine and you reach, grow, work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: You make it all about you
Let the reflex make the decision
